{{Quote|We haven't yet put explosives under all the floors to blow the place up when we leave. ''Then'' it becomes like home.''"<br />"''You are your father’s daughter.|Jesmin Tainer and Voort "Piggy" saBinring|<ref name="Mercy Kill" />}}
'''Jesmin Tainer''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] as an undercover agent and later as a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in [[Wraith Squadron]]. She was the daughter of the pilots [[Kell Tainer]] and [[Tyria Sarkin Tainer]] and sister to [[Doran Sarkin-Tainer]].

In [[43 ABY]], using the false identification of a former Jedi apprentice [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Anzat (species)|Anzat]] turned [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] named '''Zilaash Kuh''', Tainer was tasked by the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] to assist in the arrest of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], and later to capture rogue [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Valin Horn]], who had gone on a destructive rampage after suffering a [[Force psychosis|psychotic breakdown]]. After failing to capture Horn because of the intervention of Skywalker, Jesmin Tainer, still undercover, was paired up with [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Dhidal Nyz]] to [[Raid on the Armand Isard Correctional Facility|capture]] [[Seff Hellin]], a rogue Jedi suffering from the same disease as Horn. However, they lost their target to [[Darkmeld]], a secret organization formed by Jedi Knight [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] to counter [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]]'s attempts to undermine the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Kuh soon after disappeared from Coruscant, and by [[44 ABY]] the Galactic Alliance still had not tracked her down as Tainer stopped using the alias.

Tainer was afterwards recruited by [[Garik Loran]], and joined the reformed Wraith Squadron. During Wraith Squadron's investigation into Galactic Alliance [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]]'s involvement with the [[Lecersen Conspiracy]], Tainer revealed that she had adopted the mantle of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] Zilaash Kuh during [[Natasi Daala]]'s reign as Chief of State of the GA.

==Biography==
===Early Life===
{{Quote|Jezzie?''"<br />"''I've known her since we were kids. Old nicknames are hard to forget.|Voort "Piggy" saBinring and Myri Antilles|<ref name="Mercy Kill" />}}
Due to Kell choosing to remain with Wraith Squadron while Tyria left military service to study the ways of the Force, the Sarkin-Tainers often had a long-distance marriage, and Jesmin and her brother, Doran, were not raised much together. Both children were eventually trained as Jedi, although Jesmin was apparently much closer with other Starfighter Command families growing up than Doran: her parents' former commanding officer, [[Garik Loran]], was a ''de facto'' uncle to her and [[Myri Antilles]], youngest daughter of [[Wraith Squadron]]-founder and famed starfighter pilot [[Wedge Antilles]], was close to Jesmin throughout her childhood.<ref name="Mercy Kill" />

Jesmin also considered herself a highly skilled pilot, although readily conceded that Myri was better.<ref name="Mercy Kill" />

===Arrest of Skywalker===
{{Quote|Who are you?''"<br />"''Zilaash Kuh. Not, I am afraid, at your service.|Luke Skywalker and Jesmin Tainer|<ref name="Outcast" />}}
In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], Jesmin Tainer was tasked by [[Galactic Alliance Security]] to infiltrate [[Daala's special-missions force]] under a false identity. Tainer then created the persona of Zilaash Kuh, a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Anzat (species)|Anzat]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who joined the [[New Jedi Order]] as a human and was expelled from the Order when the deception was discovered, only keeping her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] as a reminder of her time as a Jedi apprentice. "Kuh", alongside the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] bounty hunter [[Dhidal Nyz]] and [[Skakoan/Legends|Skakoan]] hunter [[Hrym Mawarr]], was then hired by [[Galactic Alliance Security]] to assist in the arrest of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] under the supervision of Security [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Savar]].<ref name="Outcast" />

===Tracking rogue Jedi===
{{Quote|The Chief of State has ordered us to take the rogue Jedi into custody. Surely you've heard of her. Natasi Daala.|Jesmin Tainer, to Luke Skywalker, on Valin Horn|<ref name="Outcast" />}}
Tainer was later hired by [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]] to capture rogue [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Valin Horn]], who was suffering from a [[Force psychosis|psychotic]] breakdown that made him believe that everyone he knew&mdash;except for others suffering from the same disease&mdash;had been replaced by impostors. During the hunt for Horn, Tainer was assisted by the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] bounty hunter [[Kaddit]]. They were unsuccessful, however, as Skywalker captured the fugitive Jedi.<ref name="Outcast" />

Shortly after Skywalker's [[The Galactic Federation of Free Alliances versus Luke Skywalker|trial]] and [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]] from the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for dereliction of duty, Galactic Alliance Security was issued a warrant from Daala for the arrest of Horn. Under the command of Captain Savar, Galactic Alliance Security forces&mdash;accompanied by Tainer and the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Vrannin Vaxx]]&mdash;went to the [[New Jedi Temple|Jedi Temple]] and arrested Horn. He was then [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|encased]] in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] and taken to the [[Armand Isard Correctional Facility]], a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] on Coruscant.<ref name="Outcast" />

In a [[Raid on the Armand Isard Correctional Facility|later mission]], Tainer again teamed up with Dhidal Nyz, this time to capture [[Seff Hellin]], a rogue Jedi suffering from the same psychosis as Horn. Because the psychosis made Hellin believe that everyone but Horn had been replaced with an impostor, he attempted to free Horn from the Armand Isard Correctional Facility. Tainer piloted Nyz's [[Cargo hauler/Legends|cargo hauler]] to the prison, and Nyz captured Hellin in an electric-pulse net. However, members of [[Darkmeld]]&mdash;a secret group formed by Jedi Knight [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] to counter Daala's attempts to undermine the Jedi Order&mdash;intervened, and captured Hellin themselves. In the ensuing [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] chase, a security speeder&mdash;stolen and piloted by the bounty hunter and Darkmeld affiliate [[Tahiri Veila]]&mdash;maneuvered underneath Nyz's and Tainer's cargo hauler. Veila's partner, [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]], ravaged the bottom of the hauler with his [[Beskar/Legends|''beskar'']] [[Crushgaunt/Legends|crushgaunts]]. The hauler began to malfunction, and Tainer and Nyz fell behind and were forced to give up the bounty.<ref name="Outcast" /> Soon afterward, Tainer stopped using her bounty hunter alias and the Galactic Alliance Security stated that Kuh identification documents were indeed forgeries, but that her true identity and whereabouts remained a mystery to the government.<ref name="Conviction">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]''</ref>

===Wraith Squadron===
Following the Jedi Order's exile from Coruscant, Jesmin Tainer, the true identity of Kuh, revealed about her disguise to her fellow [[Wraith Squadron]] members during the investigation into GA [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]]'s involvement in the [[Lecersen Conspiracy]].

Tainer worked well with her fellow Wraiths as they proceeded through the mission in apprehending Thaal, and in the end, they succeeded.

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Care to surrender the prisoner? It will save everybody trouble.|Tainer, to Skywalker, after the latter captured Horn|<ref name="Outcast" />}}
Tainer under the alias of Kuh was somewhat domineering, and frequently attempted to take control of situations. She considered herself to be superior in comparison to others, especially the Jedi Order, whose popularity had [[Anti-Jedi sentiment/Legends|fallen]] in the public eye in light of recent events&mdash;including [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo's]] fall to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] and transformation into the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Caedus, along with Hellin's insanity, Horn's rampage, and Skywalker's trial and subsequent exile. Kuh was well-known for her use of a personal lightsaber, and was also adept at piloting, as she flew Nyz's cargo hauler during their attempt to capture Hellin.<ref name="Outcast" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|One shot, one kill. That’s the Ranger way.|Jesmin Tainer|<ref name="Mercy Kill" />}}
”Tainer was capable in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] using a combination of [[Telepathy/Legends|telepathy]] and [[Mind trick/Legends|Force persuasion]] to make an [[Unidentified male Concussor officer (Auxiliary bridge)|officer]] on the ''[[Concussor]]'' need to use the [[Refresher/Legends|refresher]] by sending him mental images of waterfalls, wine bottles pouring, faucets gushing, and fountains flowing. She was then able to use a burst of [[Force speed/Legends|Force-boosted speed]] to run down a chamber on the ''Concussor''.<ref name="Mercy Kill" />

Tainer was also raised and trained by the Antarian Rangers, giving her an extensive wilderness experience.<ref name="Mercy Kill" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|You're not a Jedi.|Luke Skywalker, to Tainer|<ref name="Outcast" />}}
[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] through her Jedi mother, [[Tyria Sarkin Tainer]], Jesmin utilized a lightsaber as her personal weapon. After the [[New Jedi Order]] strenuously analyzed [[Hologram/Legends|holos]] of Tainer during her times as Zilaash Kuh, they discovered that her lightsaber's [[Lightsaber hilt/Legends|hilt]] appeared to have been modeled on the hilt of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] last lightsaber. During the hunt for Horn, Tainer flew with Kaddit in a racer speeder, and in the later raid on the Armand Isard Correctional Facility, she piloted Nyz's flatbed cargo hauler while he attempted to capture Hellin.<ref name="Outcast" />

She also carried identification documents that were excellent forgeries due to her status as Galactic Alliance Security undercover agent.<ref name="Conviction" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zilaash Kuh was created by [[Aaron Allston]] for his first [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] novel, ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]'', released on [[March 24]], [[2009]]. She later received brief mention in Allston's ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]'', the seventh novel overall and Allston's third and final installment in the series. In ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'', the first post-''Fate of the Jedi'' novel, which was also written by Allston, the author revealed that it was [[Wraith Squadron]] member Jesmin Tainer, the daughter of [[Kell Tainer|Kell]] and [[Tyria Sarkin Tainer]], who adopted the persona of Zilaash Kuh.

Jesmin was named in honor of [[Jesmin Ackbar]], the first Wraith to die in Allston's debut novel, ''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''.
